entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: A surreal, always-changing plane whose geography mirrors the thoughts of its inhabitants, a multiversal hub; later the eternal prison of Bolas and Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker, brother of Bolas, killed by Bolas in the Meditation Realm and reborn from its waters; later jailer of Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker, Ugin's brother, who killed Ugin and made the realm his seat; later imprisoned nameless by Ugin.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who faked Bolas's death at Ugin's behest and later cast a reality-bending spell with Ugin's Spirit-Gem, shattering himself.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane of which the Meditation Plane was once a subplane.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Champion of Madara who fled into the realm carrying Lord Dark's essence and cleaved Bolas's spirit in half.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Practiced with Tetsuo to learn how to physically travel to the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: The emperor's assassin killed by Tetsuo in the Imperial Shrine.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: His latent planeswalker spark let Bolas escape his prison.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Dragon-worshipping planeswalker debriefed by Bolas and later desparked, who took dragon form on Tarkir.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker whose unconscious body Bolas was reconstructing.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Offered leadership over the Golgari by Bolas if she found the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: Linked to Ugin and able to scry his memories of the plane.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Angelic planeswalker who fought Sarkhan and traveled to the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Planeswalker whose mindset helped the others clear their minds in the realm.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Warned Elspeth and Narset about Sarkhan's dragon form.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature found with Jace involved in the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon whose rebirth Ugin helped.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Gem made from Ugin's essence between Bolas's horns; Jace later stole Ugin's.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Bolas wanted Vraska to find on Ixalan.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The event after which the Meditation Plane became a pocket plane of its own.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica during which Ugin resided in the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms appearing across the Multiverse that Elspeth and Narset investigated.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Dominarian island chain where Bolas fell and where the Madaran empire guarded access to the realm.

events.summary: Ugin and Bolas fight for days, years and generations before returning to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas kills Ugin; the resulting waves fling Bolas to Madara.
The wrecked plane restores itself, and Ugin is reborn from its waters.
events.quote: The dragon was reborn and floated above a once again dry seabed beneath the luminous sky.

events.summary: Bolas makes the realm his seat, raising two gigantic horns from the waters.
events.quote: he erected two gigantic curved horns so they emerged from the waters

events.summary: Tetsuo flees into the realm, reveals his plan and cleaves Bolas's spirit in half before escaping to Madara as the realm's boundaries collapse.
events.quote: The champion cleaved the elder dragon's spirit in half and narrowly escaped to Madara

events.summary: Using Venser's latent spark, Bolas escapes his prison and regains his body from an earlier point in time.
events.quote: regaining his body by pulling a copy of it through the rift from an earlier point in time

events.summary: After the Mending, the Meditation Plane becomes a pocket plane; Sarkhan visits and is debriefed by Bolas.
events.quote: the Meditation Plane became a pocket plane of its own, separate from Dominaria

events.summary: Bolas offers Vraska leadership over the Golgari if she finds the Immortal Sun on Ixalan.
events.quote: Bolas offered her leadership over the Golgari if she traveled to Ixalan

events.summary: After Bolas's faked death, Ugin secretly takes the mortal Bolas to the realm, reveals the Spirit-Gem and strips him of both names.
events.quote: Ugin then took away both of Bolas's names and rendered the fallen one nameless.

events.summary: Ugin declares himself Bolas's jailer for eternity and spreads himself over the realm, making it a prison for both.
events.quote: The Realm thus became an eternal prison for Bolas and Ugin alike.

events.summary: On Tarkir, Elspeth questions Narset about the dragonstorms; Sarkhan fights Elspeth and is quickly defeated.
events.quote: his desparked form was no match for the archangel and he was quickly defeated

events.summary: Elspeth and Narset follow a ragged Omenpath in the heart of the storm to the Meditation Realm and encounter Jace and Loot.
events.quote: they happened on Jace Beleren and the creature Loot

events.summary: In the realm the group meets the two sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless Bolas seeks a chance to regain power.
events.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power

events.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and casts a spell to reshape the realm; unable to sustain it, he shatters like glass as reality unmakes.
events.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

events.summary: All present, including Bolas, flee the realm; later it reforms with the reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak.
events.quote: a reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak manifested in its waters

relations.note: Killed him in the Meditation Realm; Ugin was later reborn.

relations.quote: the two planeswalking brothers confronted each other
he would become his jailer for eternity

relations.note: Gem between Bolas's horns was made from Ugin's essence.
relations.quote: had been made from Ugin's essence

relations.note: Offered her leadership of the Golgari if she located the Immortal Sun.
relations.quote: Bolas offered her leadership over the Golgari
The champion cleaved the elder dragon's spirit in half

relations.note: Faked Bolas's death at Ugin's behest.
relations.quote: Jace Beleren had faked Bolas's death at Ugin's behest
